reproduction: Raw municipal GLB/terrain/tree inputs and private source intermediates are intentionally excluded from source Git. Retrieve the pinned municipal inputs, preserve accepted source terrain words, independently convert/filter the current LoD2 source, and use cells-north/south-v3 configs with --accepted-building-manifest pointing to the exact accepted source manifest. Public OSM/WFS projections keep exact consumed values but need explicit sourceRegistration hash rebinding; their different hashes are never silently substituted. Native cache receipts bind the original producer files and input hashes. No2017mesh input.
